_why: How long words take to read — ONE table for the TypeScript that paces kinetic type (runtime/kineticCore readingSeconds) and the Python that judges it (scripts/shot_proof.py kinetic_hold_findings). tests/test_kinetic.py pins the shared numbers to scripts/validate.py's caption rule.

sources.cps.zh: Netflix Simplified Chinese timed-text style guide: <= 9 characters/s (adult)
sources.cps.ja: Netflix Japanese timed-text style guide: <= 4 characters/s
sources.cps.latin: Netflix English timed-text style guide: <= 20 characters/s (adult)
sources.cps.ko: no Korean figure was sourced; the nearest sourced CJK rate (zh), as validate.py's caption rule already applies to Hangul
sources.minSeconds: Netflix: a subtitle event is at least 5/6 s
sources.mustReadSecondsPerWord: ssw.com.au: text that must be understood is held long enough to read twice at 200 wpm (~0.6 s a word)
